messages:
maria: incident-bot: Detected sustained p99 spike on /v1/stream in us-west-2 — p95 from 1200ms -> 3400ms, p99 > 5200ms. Error rate (502/stream abort) up for Acme Payments. Paging metrics show GPU host g2-47 kernel page faults up 12x after a kernel compile/roll 28m ago (trt8 + flashattn v2) :boom:

devon: I see the same in Grafana. Live traces show stalls during decode() at token 512-1024. KV cache hits unchanged. Example trace ids: trace-abc123, trace-def456

yuki: quick note — buildmaster rolled kernel build `rwin-kernel-2026-03-15-7` about 30m ago, included compile flags `-O3 -ffast-math -DTRT_FLASH=1`. Paging on that host correlates with compiletime changes. Also saw cgroup memory reclaim thrashing in vmstat.

sre-bot: node-metrics: g2-47: GPU mem 98%, host mem 94%, major pagefaults 1190/min, io wait 23%. Pod `runtime-decode-usw2-7` P95 latency 3.7s.

depon-bot: deploy: rollback candidate: `rwin-kernel-2026-03-15-6` (previous). Can trigger hot-rollback via /ops/rollback-kernel -- requires node drain.

devon: mitigation plan attempt 1: cordon+drain g2-47, shift traffic via routing policy to fallback region/us-east-1 and smaller model variant (redwood-llm-small) for affected customer. Doing now. I'll also enable streaming-graceful-timeout=200ms to reduce headroom retries.

maria: +1 for drain. Also open support ticket to Acme Payments, prepping customer-facing note. Assigning page to @marcus for handoff in 12m if we need extended work.

marcus: standing by. If rollback required, I'll run the kernel hotpatch. If not, will continue triage. What's the impact to SLA? we are breaching p99 SLO (5s) for that route.

yuki: quick test locally: switching off `-DTRT_FLASH=1` in build reduced major faults and p99 in a perf env from 4.8s -> 2.1s. So strong candidate.

devon: executed `kubectl cordon g2-47` -> success. Starting `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data runtime-decode-usw2-7` (logs:
```
Evicting pod runtime-decode-usw2-7
Pod evicted
Scheduling new pod runtime-decode-usw2-11 in us-west-2
```
)

sre-bot: routing: 60% of traffic shifted to us-east-1, 40% to us-west-2 fallback nodes. Token-level logs show reduced tail retries.

maria: customer update sent: short note apologizing + mitigation in progress. Support ticket #INC-20260315-ACME created.

devon: after drain, p95 back to ~1.3s, p99 ~1.9s on rerouted traffic. Error rate for Acme Payments dropped to baseline. Still seeing 2 nodes with high reclaim — scheduling full rollback for g2-47 if it returns to traffic.

yuki: preparing kernel rollback artifact now — will coordinate with Marcus to apply hotpatch: `rwin-kernel-2026-03-15-6`.

marcus: applying rollback on g2-47 (hotpatch mode) in 3m. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollback `rwin-kernel-2026-03-15-6` -> g2-47. ETA 4m.

depon-bot: NOTE: rollback will drop some tensorRT optimizations; expect ~5-10% throughput change but improved tail latency.

marcus: rollback completed. Rebooted node, runtime pods started. Observed immediate p99 drop to 1.8s on g2-47. Major faults down to 120/min.

maria: confirmed customer metrics normalizing. Marking incident as mitigated for now. Preparing post-incident follow-up: timeline, root-cause hypothesis (compile flags + kernel changes interacting with GPU memory allocator -> paging), and next steps: 1) revert compile flags in next kernel build, 2) add canary rollout gating tied to pagefaults/p99, 3) add automatic fallback to smaller model variant on p95 surge.

devon: will open PR to add canary gating (metrics: major_pagefaults, p99_latency) and extend rollback playbook. Also plan more stress tests of TRT+FlashAttention combos under high-concurrency.

maria: handoff to _next oncall_ @marcus for 1h monitoring. If anything resurfaces, escalate to Eng Runtime. Closing thread unless new alerts occur. :white_check_mark:
